// diagnostic E3007

Jet.ComptimeEndedBySignal

Compile-time code was ended by {signal} from outside jet

What

Compile-time code was ended by {signal} from outside jet

Why

Jet runs compile-time code in a process of its own, and another process or the system (as when memory runs out) sent that process {signal}, so the code never finished; jet and the program did not raise it

Fix

Build again without stopping it; if the system ended it because memory ran out, free memory or make the compile-time work smaller.

Worked example

First UI snapshot mentioning Jet.ComptimeEndedBySignal: Tests/UI/comptime_ended_by_an_outside_signal.stderr.
